item.title: Bots - Swahili language support for Challenge Pages
item.description:
Cloudflare Challenge Pages now support Swahili (Kenya), allowing visitors whose browser language preference is sw or sw-ke to receive a localized challenge experience.

Refer to supported languages for more information about language detection and supported language codes.

item.title: Bots - New options to manage AI traffic
item.description: All customers can now manage AI crawlers by behavior — Search, Agent, and Training — instead of a single Block AI bots toggle. Configure these options from Block AI Bots. New defaults, in which Training and Agent are blocked on pages that display ads while Search remains allowed, take effect for new domains on September 15, 2026.

item.title: Bots - BotBase and Business Insights for Enterprise Bot Management
item.description: Enterprise Bot Management customers can now use BotBase, a searchable directory of all tracked bots and agents with their behavior classification and detection IDs, and Business Insights, a dashboard showing site-wide and per-operator crawl-to-referral ratios alongside bot traffic to your content.

item.title: Bots - Managed robots.txt will prepend existing files
item.description: Cloudflare will prepend our managed robots.txt before your existing robots.txt, combining both into a single response.

item.title: Bots - Web Bot Auth is now available for bot verification
item.description: Web Bot Auth is an authentication method that leverages cryptographic signatures in HTTP messages to verify that a request comes from an automated bot. This provides a more robust way of verifying bots.

item.title: Bots - Anomaly detection events now receive a bot score of 2
item.description: Events detected by the anomaly detection engine are now given a bot score of 2.

item.title: Bots - Machine Learning model v9 is now the default model
item.description: Machine Learning model v9 is now the default model for all new zones and existing zones set to use the latest machine learning model.

item.title: Bots - Managed robots.txt is now available
item.description: Direct AI crawlers on what they can and cannot scrape from your website or application by implementing a robots.txt file to your domain.

item.title: Bots - Bot Detection Alerts are now available
item.description: You can now create a Bot Detection Alert to notify you when Cloudflare detects a spike in Bot traffic on your website.

item.title: Bots - AI bots is now a managed rule
item.description: AI bots protection has been upgraded from a custom rule to a managed rule.
